summary: Optimi Health Corp., a commercial-stage psychedelic pharmaceutical manufacturer (Canada-domiciled, foreign private issuer filing a US-equivalent Form 6-K), furnished a press release announcing plans for a Health Canada-authorized Phase 3 clinical trial of its synthetic MDMA HCl in MDMA-assisted therapy for PTSD. The trial is expected to begin in 2027, targeting enrollment of up to 100 veterans and frontline workers across multiple Canadian sites, with two supervised dosing sessions and CAPS-5 as the primary efficacy endpoint. No price, stake, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or financial terms are stated; this is an operational/scientific update.
